title: Lightroom alignment
objective: Make every supported slider do about what the same value does in Lightroom Classic: measure each setting's response from rendered outputs, calibrate the importers' conversions in the meantime, realign each control's response by editing area, and change an algorithm only where a dimension still differs past the threshold.
context_summary: Planned from docs/design/lightroom-alignment.md, the contract every task follows; the owner decided every question on 2026-10-06 and did not authorize implementation, so nothing here starts until authorized. Lightroom is driven by generated XMP and one manual import and export per round by the owner; agents cannot run Lightroom. Only rendered outputs are compared: no Adobe code, SDK source or binary is read or used, and no Adobe data ships. Response changes run by editing area (Basic and the Tone curve, then Presence, the mixer and the vignette, then Detail, then masks and geometry, then RAW white balance); each raises its module's format marker so earlier recipes are refused. Behaviour changes follow only past the threshold (median ΔE2000 above 2 at ±25 and beyond, or a difference in kind). Decisions: docs/decisions.md.

tasks.description: Build the rig's generator: the synthetic JPEG targets (grey wedge, Oklab patch grid, edge and zone-plate chart, flat field, geometric grids), the corpus selection, and cargo xtask lr-align generate, which writes a round folder of copies with each variant's settings as XMP and a manifest.
extra_context: Only the round's own copies carry XMP: embedded in a JPEG copy, a sidecar beside a RAW copy. Originals and the corpus are never written.
Every variant's XMP must read back through Luxforge's own preset reader to the manifest's settings.
Round 1 is single settings across each range; round 2 the interacting pairs the design names. Supplied and corpus RAW files come from their manifests; none enter the repository.

context_links.relevance: The CC0 RAW files the rounds use.

context_links.label: Preset XMP reader
context_links.relevance: The reader every variant round-trips through.

acceptance_criteria: A round is deterministic: generating twice gives identical folders and manifests.
Every variant round-trips through the preset reader; the generator writes only inside the round folder.

steps: Generate a round twice and compare; run the round-trip tests.
expected_results: Both rounds are identical and every variant round-trips.

tasks.description: Build measurement and fitting: render each variant through the CPU reference renderer, read Lightroom's 16-bit TIFF exports, measure responses relative to each editor's neutral rendering, fit a monotone map per setting with its residual and range shortfall, and write per-setting pages, contact sheets and a ranked summary (cargo xtask lr-align measure).
extra_context: The TIFF decoder is a pinned development dependency of the study, never of the editor.

Measures: transfer curves, ΔE2000 and signed ΔL*, Oklab chroma ratio and hue shift per sector, overshoot and halo width, band gain, radial profiles, grid positions; each checked on synthetic cases with known answers.
Outputs only: no Adobe code, SDK source or binary is read or used.

context_links.label: Lightroom alignment design
context_links.locator: Measuring a response, not a look

acceptance_criteria: Every measure recovers its known answer on synthetic cases; maps are monotone; shortfalls are reported, never clamped.

steps: Run the measurement and fit tests on synthetic cases.

tasks.description: Run round 1 with the owner: single-setting sweeps over every supported setting, measured and fitted, with the figures, residuals and the settings past the A8 threshold recorded in the design.
extra_context: The owner imports the round folder into a scratch Lightroom catalog and exports it with the round's export settings (16-bit TIFF, sRGB, full size, no output sharpening, no metadata); agents cannot run Lightroom.
acceptance_criteria: Every supported setting has a page with its response curves, map, residual and sheet, and the design records the summary.

steps: Generate round 1, hand it to the owner, measure the exports, record the figures.
commands: cargo xtask lr-align measure --round 1 --exports DIR --output NEW_DIR
expected_results: The round's figures are recorded in the design.

tasks.description: Add the calibrated mapping rows: each fitted level A map becomes a frozen fixture and a calibrated rule in the preset mapping, used by preset import and the Lightroom import until that setting's response change lands, with the report naming the rule applied.
extra_context: One mapping table; the calibrated rule sits beside value transfer and curve transfer.
acceptance_criteria: Each calibrated row converts exactly as its fixture says; uncalibrated rows are unchanged; the report says which rule applied.

tasks.description: Run round 2 with the owner: the interacting pairs (Exposure with Highlights and Whites, Contrast with Blacks and Whites, Vibrance with Saturation, Clarity with Texture, Dehaze with Contrast), checking that single-setting maps hold together and reporting pairs whose combined residual grows sharply.
extra_context: Same owner round-trip as round 1.
acceptance_criteria: The pairs' figures are recorded in the design, with any pair that breaks its single-setting maps named.

steps: Generate round 2, hand it to the owner, measure, record.
commands: cargo xtask lr-align measure --round 2 --exports DIR --output NEW_DIR

tasks.description: Realign Basic tone and colour (Exposure, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites, Blacks, Vibrance, Saturation, JPEG Temperature and Tint) and the Tone curve to Lightroom's responses.
extra_context: Each response change follows the design's path: a study with figures and contact sheets, the f64 reference refrozen, the CPU unit exact against it, the GPU program within the declared tolerance, the module's payload format marker raised so earlier recipes are refused, the owner's review of the sheets before freezing, and the setting's level A map refitted to the identity within tolerance.
The algorithm, stage and processing cost stay unchanged; a confirming Lightroom round by the owner closes each batch.
A setting past the A8 threshold is recorded with the dimension that differs, for a behaviour-change task.

tasks.description: Validate on the owner's real edits and document: cargo xtask lr-align validate reads the owner's catalog read-only with consent asked each run, renders a sample of edited photographs through the import mapping with and without calibration, compares each with Lightroom's preview, and records the figures; the user guide, feature status and design describe what is built.
extra_context: Needs the Lightroom catalog reader and preview reading by name; figures only, nothing leaves the machine or is committed.
Base rendering differences are measured on unedited photographs and reported separately.
acceptance_criteria: The median difference against Lightroom's previews, calibrated and not, is recorded; docs describe current behaviour only; the quick tier passes.

steps: Run validation with the owner's consent; update the docs; run the quick tier.
expected_results: Check and quick pass; the figures are recorded.
